description: Two-variant call-to-action button with optional animated slide-in arrow. No content contract beyond its own props — a primitive, not a section.

children.description: button label, rendered uppercase via mono font

href.description: renders an <a> instead of <button> when present

motion.hover: button--primary/secondary radius narrows on hover (motion.durations.standard, ease)
motion.animatedArrow: arrow slides in from right on hover when animated=true
